title: STARTEX — Communications Cell Opens, 07:30 ET

fields.location: Tallis Home Products, Inc. — Communications Cell, Conference Room 3B, fourth floor, Dayton, Ohio
fields.weather: Overcast, 38°F. Light drizzle forecast for the morning commute.
fields.load: Normal weekday: about 11,000 web store orders expected today; customer care queue at 14 waiting calls
fields.staffing: Communications Cell called together by the CCO; customer care day shift on; SOC in Dayton staffed 24 hours
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 07:30 Eastern Time on Tuesday, March 9, 2027, in Dayton, Ohio, and Chief Communications Officer Marcus Delaney has just called the Communications Cell together in Conference Room 3B. The web store at tallishome.example is on normal weekday load, status.tallishome.example shows all systems operational, and nothing about any incident has been posted on the newsroom page or the company accounts. The bridge line (937) 555-0149, code 4100, is live, workstations TLC-COM-01, TLC-COM-02 and TLC-COM-03 are logged in, the fact sheet is empty, and the market opens at 09:30.
